##### Project General Facts

Monte Carlo embodies the essence of refined living, with its exquisite design aesthetic and premium townhouses that exemplify elegance and poise, boasting bright white walls, double-height windows, and sleek wooden features that contrast beautifully with exposed brick pillars, paying homage to Monte Carlo's rich history. The townhouses feature ample natural light, highlighting the pure white and wooden elements indoors, while high ceilings lend each unit a measure of poise and grace, creating a sense of serenity and tranquility. With its unique blend of modernity and nods to its storied past, Monte Carlo presents an exceptional living experience, with lush living spaces that seamlessly transition into private areas, striking a perfect balance between elegance and functionality.

Monte Carlo features an array of amenities, including the Aqua Opera School House pavilion, a gorgeous floating opera house that provides evenings of entertainment in style, playing host to concerts and performances by some of the world's finest singers and musicians, as well as the board game casino pavilion, which entertains children for hours with exotic board games and card games from around the world. The Vintage Car Museum is another notable amenity, showcasing an impressive collection of classic American and European automobiles, allowing car enthusiasts to admire and even take some of the vehicles out for a spin. These amenities create a unique and desirable living environment, with an abundance of space for creating cherished memories.

The interior finishing of Monte Carlo showcases modern finishing with high-quality materials, complemented by a timeless design that incorporates fresh, warm tones and calm, relaxed atmospheres, which create a sense of serenity and tranquility, perfect for unwinding and enjoying quality time with loved ones. The townhouses are designed to bring home the glamour of Monte Carlo, with ample space and elegant features that make them truly special, featuring high ceilings, pure white and wooden elements, and an abundance of natural light, making them a true masterpiece of design and functionality.


##### Location description and benefits

Damac Lagoons is a conveniently located community, hidden away along Hessa Street, right opposite the DAMAC Hills community, putting residents within minutes of the city's key arterial freeways, such as Mohammed Bin Zayed Road and Emirates Road. The location provides easy access to several key destinations, including the Dubai Polo & Equestrian Club, Dubai Autodrome, and Miracle Garden, all of which are just a short drive away. The community is also close to several top-rated schools, including Jebel Ali School and Fairgreen International School, making it an ideal location for families.

Damac Lagoons is surrounded by a range of amenities and attractions, including the Dubai International Stadium, Global Village, and IMG World, all of which are within a short drive. The community is also close to several malls, including First Avenue Mall and City Centre Meaisem, providing residents with a range of shopping and dining options. The location is also convenient for travel, with Al Maktoum International Airport just a short drive away, making it easy to get to and from the community.

The location of Damac Lagoons provides residents with a unique blend of comfort, convenience, and luxury, with easy access to a range of amenities and attractions, as well as several top-rated schools and hospitals, including Mediclinic Parkview Hospital and NMC Royal Hospital. The community is also close to several hotels, including Park Inn by Radisson and Studio One Hotel, making it an ideal location for both residents and visitors. The location is serviced by several major roads, including Al Khail Road, making it easy to get around the city.
